retraction.true_status: False when shipped. The Usage quick-controls sheet persisted five Settings-owned policies to localStorage (warn before running low, automatic account/provider switching, continuation product, continuation 'then' action, extra paid usage, spending limit) and dispatched zero commands and zero deep links. The deep-link machinery described above exists, but the policy controls did not use it.
retraction.measured_evidence: PM_Usage_Independent_Audit_2026-08-17/audit-evidence/probes/axis1-ownership-probe-results.json — five persisted 'u11:settings' writes with a cmdLog delta of 0; U11.deepLink pushes a semantic.deep link entry into that same log (u11-data.js:1410), so an empty log proves no deep link occurred. 27 of the 30 settings-directed controls in the UI never reach U11.deepLink at all (A10-08).
retraction.scope: The clause is retracted, not re-asserted in weaker words. Repair of the sheet is a separate change; no claim about local policy mutation belongs in this register until a harness measures the repaired sheet.

vocabulary_correction.retracted_text: Semantic deep link to Settings/owner - U11.deepLink() - settings/providers (routing, reconnect), settings/usage (usage_and_extra_usage)
vocabulary_correction.why_the_claim_was_false: The stage named a destination vocabulary that does not exist. Plans/settings_inventory.json has 12 categories and neither 'providers' nor 'usage' is one of them - 'providers' is a subgroup of web meaning web-search providers, and 'usage' is a subgroup of ai. The tokens focus_reason, usage_and_extra_usage, usage_quick_controls and see_all have zero occurrences anywhere under Plans/ (measured 2026-08-18). A wiring chain that terminates in a destination canon does not define is not wired.

production_event_types_2026_08_18.finding: A11-22 (info) - closed as recorded, not as repaired.
production_event_types_2026_08_18.what_was_measured: Every production wiring row whose key or ui_command_id contains 'usage' carries expected_event_types []. There are five of them, one more than the four the audit named, because catalog.usage_forecast_request has been added since.

rows.effect_contract: effect_kind 'receipt' - 'cmd.usage.refresh has no declared persisted event; dispatch must still record a no-persist command receipt or route/open disposition.' receipt_or_event_refs ['cmd.usage.refresh.dispatch_receipt']

production_event_types_2026_08_18.the_one_exception: Of the canonical commands this concept reuses, exactly one declares a domain event: catalog.account_select_profile (cmd.account.select_profile) with ['account_switch_event'] and effect_kind 'event'. That is the one the concept previously misbound to a view filter, which audit A11-02 scored; the scope picker now dispatches nothing at all, and the harness case 'closure changing the page scope dispatches no command' holds it there.
production_event_types_2026_08_18.denominator: Plans/DRY_Rules.md, section 'Unresolved schema and Event Authority boundary' (:2132-2143), states at :2139 that 'The Event Authority denominator remains UNKNOWN_OPEN. No event family is inferred, registered, or declared emitted from a service name in this registry.' Admission of a new event family is an Event Authority adjudication, not something a concept register can perform.
production_event_types_2026_08_18.consequence_for_this_concept: The extended attempt schema, the meter schema, the four new collections and the renumbered ids proposed in event-schema-delta.json have no production wiring row that would carry them as events. They are receipt-and-projection shapes, which is what the existing wiring rows actually declare (effect_kind 'receipt'), and they must be read that way until an Event Authority adjudication says otherwise.
production_event_types_2026_08_18.what_this_register_does_not_do: It does not name, invent or propose an event family for the Usage surface, and it does not treat the receipt contracts above as evidence that one exists. The honest state is: zero usage event families admitted, denominator UNKNOWN_OPEN, and the proposals stand as unattached until an owner adjudicates.

source_citation_policy: Source citations into u11-prism.html, u11-data.js, u11-widgets.js, u11-rundetail.js and u11-context.js name a symbol, identifier or exact string rather than a line number. Those five files were under concurrent edit on 2026-08-18 - u11-data.js moved twice while this repair was being written - so a line number here would be wrong by the time it was read. Line numbers are retained only for files that are stable in this pass: everything under Plans/ and under _shared/. Text preserved inside a `retraction` or `retracted_claim` object is left exactly as it was written, line numbers included, because its purpose is to record what a document said on a past date.
